Turning the mandelbrot set inside out.

This video was made with the following math: z2 + (n * f-1) * c + (1-n * f-1) * t

where n is the number of the frame being rendered, and f is the total number of frames to be rendered, and t is some arbitrary transformation of c, in this case, c-1. (z and c are part of the normal mandelbrot function. c = the point on the complex plane that you are rendering, and z = the value obtained on the previous iteration. On iteration 0, z = 0 , giving 02 + c, iteration one is equal to c2+c, and so forth)

Naturally, the math can be shifted to look at arbitrary transformations of z, as well. Or arbitrary transformations between fractal functions. It's pretty flexible.
